title: What Is a Stablecoin? Why Some Crypto Tries Not to Move (Beginner Guide)
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. What a stablecoin is, why it exists, and what can still go wrong. Plain English for beginners. AI-generated voice.

scenes.head: CRYPTO THAT STAYS STILL?
scenes.narration: Most crypto jumps around all day. So what is a coin that is built to stay at one price?

scenes.head: WHAT IT IS
items: A coin tied to an asset
scenes.narration: A stablecoin is a crypto coin designed to track another asset, most often the US dollar, aiming for one to one.

scenes.head: WHY IT EXISTS
scenes.narration: People use them to move value quickly, to hold value between trades, and to send money across borders.

scenes.head: HOW IT STAYS STABLE
scenes.narration: Some are backed by cash and similar reserves. Others are backed by crypto, or by code rules that try to hold the price.

scenes.head: IT CAN SLIP
scenes.narration: Stable does not mean safe. A coin can lose its peg if people doubt the reserves or the rules behind it.

scenes.head: WHAT TO CHECK
scenes.narration: Beginners often ask who holds the reserves, whether reports are published, and how the coin is regulated.
